ValidationRule.description: This is used to check if the Mobile is entered in correct format or not.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Company_Member', $Profile.Name = 'ANZ CCRM Standard User', NOT(ISBLANK(Mobile__c)), AND( NOT REGEX( Mobile__c , "^\\+614[0-9]{8}+$"), NOT REGEX( Mobile__c , "^\\+615[0-9]{8}+$") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Mobile entered is not in the correct format.
